CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_dashboard_stats(p_today timestamp with time zone)
 RETURNS json
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF NOT public.is_admin() THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Not authorized' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
  END IF;

  RETURN (
    SELECT json_build_object(
      'total_riders',       (SELECT count(*) FROM public.riders),
      'active_riders',      (SELECT count(*) FROM public.riders WHERE account_status = 'online'),
      'pending_kyc',        (SELECT count(*) FROM public.rider_kyc WHERE kyc_status = 'pending'),
      'pending_withdrawals',(SELECT count(*) FROM public.rider_withdrawals WHERE status = 'pending'),
      'today_revenue',      COALESCE((SELECT sum(final_amount) FROM public.payments WHERE payment_status = 'paid' AND created_at >= p_today), 0),
      'total_revenue',      COALESCE((SELECT sum(final_amount) FROM public.payments WHERE payment_status = 'paid'), 0)
    )
  );
END;
$function$
